notes: Both mi- + noun pairs are contiguous and rendered by one English word each (within, without), so rule 30 fusion is correctly applied and each heads on the lexeme-bearing noun.
with pure gold is the material accusative's own supplied function word (rule 33): the verb's object is the suffix it, so rule 44's supplied-preposition clause does not reach it.
lo is written here as two English words (to it), so unlike v. 11's thereto the preposition and suffix are properly split under rule 2.
